Ravi: quick follow-up from the PM 16 1 we should clean up alert priorities so we stop paging for transient bursts. scope: dedupe 5xx, adjust cpu_autoscale threshold alerts, add deploy suppressions, and publish a night/weekend paging matrix. owners below 
Nia: I can take the alert priority changes and add grouping by instance. planning to push a staging PR tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
Omar: I'll handle the paging matrix + suppression rules. plan: only page for severity=critical OR when `for >= 10m`. will create a short doc for oncall. ETA Fri. 
ops-bot: Automated: recent trend: 7 5xx spikes in last 10d; correlated with deploy tag `canary`. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/5xx-trend 
Ravi: suggested prometheus draft for 5xx collapse (staging first): 
```
alert: Backend5xxBurst
expr: increase(http_responses_total{status=~"5..",service!="health"}[5m]) > 40
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "8m"
  group_by: "job,instance"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/tree/main/runbooks/5xx"
```
Nia: acked. will include a unit test for grouping and log a staging run. expect PR by EOD tomorrow. 
Omar: for paging matrix I'll add a small escalation list and explicit `no_page` label for noisy warnings, plus `suppress_during: deploy_window`. will post draft to channel when ready. 
Jules: can we also suppress pages for alerts with `slo: informational` tag? that would help reduce noise from background jobs. 
Ravi: good call. add `no_page` for `slo=informational` and ensure runbooks still exist for ops. 
Nia: created GH issue #901 to track rule + test work: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/901 
Omar: created GH issue #902 to track paging doc & suppression rules. 
Ravi: final owners & dates: Nia (rules + tests, due: Tue COB), Omar (paging doc + suppressions, due: Fri COB), Jules (SLO suppression sweep, due: Thu). please ack. I'll run weekly triage until closed. ping me or @pagerduty if blocked. :white_check_mark:
